UPDATE totd_queue q
                SET scheduled_date = NULL,
                    assigned_by = NULL,
                    assigned_at = NULL,
                    is_auto = false
                FROM (
                    SELECT scheduled_date AS old_date
                    FROM totd_queue
                    WHERE translatable_id = $1
                ) src
                WHERE q.translatable_id = $1
                  AND src.old_date IS NOT NULL
                  AND src.old_date > current_date
                RETURNING src.old_date AS "old_date!"
